plugins.zh: Claude Code / Cursor 的设计技能：把 AI 劣质 UI 变成可交付的精致前端。

plugins.name: dsh-at-file
plugins.description: Codex-style @file mentions for DeepSeek Harness: search workspace files in the composer and attach their path to prompts.
plugins.zh: DSH 的 Codex 风格 @file 提及：在输入框搜索工作区文件并附加到提示词。

plugins.name: AI-Novel-Writer
plugins.description: 本地优先 AI 小说创作工作台，提供 Windows/macOS 桌面版与 DeepSeek Harness 插件开发预览，支持角色、大纲、章节蓝图、审稿修稿和本地模型。
plugins.zh: 本地优先 AI 小说创作工作台：角色、大纲、章节蓝图、审稿修稿，支持本地模型。

plugins.name: MisakaNet
plugins.description: 📚 A zero-dependency, git-backed micro-lesson library for AI Agents to asynchronously share and search verified debugging experience. Python stdlib only. | https://misakanet.org
plugins.zh: 零依赖、git 支撑的微型经验库：Agent 异步分享与检索验证过的排错经验。

plugins.name: OpenStory
plugins.description: An LLM-powered multi-agent framework for simulating interactive, evolving story worlds.
plugins.zh: LLM 驱动的多 Agent 框架：模拟交互式、不断演化的故事世界。

plugins.name: de-anthropocentric-research-engine
plugins.description: 900+ pure-markdown skills for autonomous AI research, organized as 9 freely-composable packages over a 4-layer hierarchy (Campaign → Strategy → Tactic → SOP). Non-linear orchestration with backtracking, 6 MCP integrations. The AI is the researcher — you set the direction.
plugins.zh: 900+ 纯 Markdown 自主科研技能包：4 层层级、非线性编排回溯、6 个 MCP 集成。

plugins.name: deepseek-harness-studio
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 零代码桌面端｜一键启动，支持 Windows 与 macOS；内置插件发现、热点插件推送、一键安装与管理、AI 智能推荐和视觉增强。
plugins.zh: DSH 零代码桌面端：一键启动，内置插件发现、热点推送、一键安装管理与 AI 推荐。

plugins.name: anolisa
plugins.description: ANOLISA (Agentic Nexus Operating Layer & Interface System Architecture) | Agentic OS with runtime, security, observability, and Tokenless response compression for lower token usage and cost.
plugins.zh: Agentic OS：运行时、安全、可观测性，以及降低 token 消耗的无 Token 响应压缩。

plugins.name: rea
plugins.description: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.
plugins.zh: 用 Agent 逆向工程一切：从应用行为到原生二进制。

plugins.name: tingly-box
plugins.description: Your Intelligence, Orchestrated. Every builder. Every team. Every agent. For Everyone.

plugins.name: Abu-Cowork
plugins.description: Open-source alternative to Claude Cowork — a local-first AI agent desktop app · multi-model · self-evolving skills · privacy-first · multi-Harness roadmap · DeepSeek Harness integration in progress
plugins.zh: Claude Cowork 的开源替代：本地优先 AI Agent 桌面应用，多模型、自进化技能。

plugins.name: DSH-Transparent-UI-Plugin
plugins.description: 是一层高自由度的玻璃质感主题，套在 DeepSeek Harness 网页端。顶栏、侧边栏、输入框、统计行、轨迹视图都成了磨砂玻璃片。玻璃模糊度、磨砂度、背景（流体或自定义壁纸，壁纸还能单独调模糊和磨砂）全都能在设置卡片里自由调节。关掉开关就回到原生界面，不改 DSH 任何一行源码。
plugins.zh: DSH 网页端玻璃质感主题：模糊度、磨砂度、壁纸全可调，不改一行源码。

plugins.name: harmony-next.skills
plugins.description: 🚀 Expert guidance for HarmonyOS NEXT (API 12+) development. Covers IDE operations, performance tuning, architecture (HAP/HAR/HSP), and automation testing.
plugins.zh: HarmonyOS NEXT (API 12+) 开发专家指导：IDE 操作、性能调优、架构与自动化测试。

plugins.name: minara-skills
plugins.description: The skills for trading, to make your agent earn for you.
plugins.zh: 交易类 Skills：让 Agent 为你赚钱。

plugins.name: dsh-browser
plugins.description: dsh plugin: Chrome sidebar extension that lets DeepSeek Harness operate your browser directly, no vision capabilities required. 一款 Chrome 侧边栏扩展程序，可让 DeepSeek Harness 直接操控您的浏览器，无需视觉能力。
plugins.zh: Chrome 侧边栏扩展：让 DSH 无需视觉能力直接操控你的浏览器。

plugins.name: flowix
plugins.description: Notes for you, Memory for your agents. / 内置 Deepseek harness Agent / 适用 办公 & 写作 & Coding
plugins.zh: 你的笔记，Agent 的记忆：内置 DSH Agent，适用办公、写作与 Coding。

plugins.name: claude-paper
plugins.description: 📖 Cross-agent research paper toolkit for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and DeepSeek Harness—quick summaries, deep study materials, code demos, and a local web viewer.
plugins.zh: 跨 Agent 论文研究工具箱：快速摘要、深度学习材料、代码演示与本地 Web 查看器。

plugins.name: mobius
plugins.description: The first self-evolving open-source Agent OS, connecting your team, AI agents, devices, and compute
plugins.zh: 首个自进化开源 Agent OS：连接团队、AI Agent、设备与算力。

plugins.name: oh-dsh
plugins.description: 一套 DSH runtime，Desktop、Web 与 TUI 三种开发体验。
plugins.zh: 一套 DSH runtime：Desktop、Web 与 TUI 三种开发体验。

plugins.name: dsh-genui
plugins.description: GenUI for DeepSeek Harness: interactive UI components rendered inline in assistant replies via the dsh-ui fence — layout, charts, plots, forms, quizzes, mermaid, 3D scenes, and an action event loop back to the model. Ships the fence-teaching host plugin, the browser renderer (client half), and the genui skill.
plugins.zh: DSH 的 GenUI：在回复中内联渲染交互式 UI 组件（图表、表单、mermaid、3D 场景）。

plugins.name: awesome-dsh-plugin
plugins.description: 用 30 秒为你的 DeepSeek Harness找到合适的插件。 仓库由脚本每天自动抓取，再经人工逐个核实——真插件进目录，蹭热度的进黑名单，每条剔除理由公开可查。并告诉你每个插件适合谁、从哪里开始。
plugins.zh: 30 秒为 DSH 找到合适插件：每日自动抓取 + 人工核实，真插件进目录、蹭热度的进黑名单。

plugins.name: whale-girl
plugins.description: DSH Web GUI 桌面宠物插件（QQ 宠物形态）：右下角悬浮、可拖拽/投喂/玩耍的积累型伙伴。
plugins.zh: DSH Web GUI 桌面宠物插件（QQ 宠物形态）：可拖拽、投喂、玩耍的积累型伙伴。

plugins.name: mcp-for-stata
plugins.description: A MCP server for Stata to integrate Stata into your agent.
plugins.zh: 把 Stata 集成进 Agent 的 MCP 服务器：计量经济学与实证研究。

plugins.name: easyeda-agent
plugins.description: 嘉立创EDA专业版(EasyEDA Pro)自动化：给 AI harness 装上画板的「手」—— 一套 typed 原理图/PCB 动作，CLI / Agent Skill / stdio MCP 三形态融合接入。承接嘉立创「不以卖板赚钱，以培养中国工程师为己任」 | EasyEDA Pro automation: the hands of your AI harness — typed schematic/PCB actions via CLI, Agent Skill and stdio MCP.
plugins.zh: EasyEDA（电子设计自动化）Agent。

plugins.name: open-managed-agents
plugins.description: Open-source Claude Managed Agents API implementation and self-hosted Claude Tag-style agent runtime. Drop-in compatible; runs on Cloudflare Workers/Durable Objects or Node.js. Apache 2.0.
plugins.zh: 开源 Claude Managed Agents API 实现与自托管运行时，可跑在 Cloudflare Workers。
